title: Weekly Commentary: Money Matters
text: The Fed Chair delivered an impressive presentation at Jackson Hole. He continues to talk a good game, and his focus on traditional central bank principles is commendable.

title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Start Week Lower
text: U.S. natural gas futures were lower, while warmer-than-normal weather extending well into September maintains some price support.

title: The U.S. Struck Iran Again On Sunday: A September Rate Hike Is Now The Base Case
text: The U.S. struck Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island on Sunday, the first strike in over a month, and Iran retaliated against two U.S. bases in Jordan. I think Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech on Friday mattered more, moving September hike odds from 36% to above 60% and changing how the market should read Iran headlines.
